edges.reason: _msgSender() is forwarded as the `from` argument into the core transfer logic.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sender of the token movement.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as spender when reducing allowance.
The constructor uses _msgSender() to receive the initial supply and ownership.
manualswap authorizes the caller by comparing _msgSender() with _FeeAddress.
manualsend authorizes the caller by comparing _msgSender() with _FeeAddress.
onlyOwner compares _owner with _msgSender() to gate privileged functions.
_msgSender simply returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
block.timestamp is compared against cooldown[to] to gate buys from the pair.
block.timestamp is passed as the Uniswap swap deadline.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
cooldown[to] is written as block.timestamp + 30 seconds, a timestamp-dependent constraint.
Parameter `from` selects branches (pair/bot/cooldown checks) inside _transfer.
Parameter `to` selects branches (pair/bot/cooldown checks) inside _transfer.
Parameter `amount` is checked against _maxTxAmount and passed to _tokenTransfer.
tokenAmount is approved and swapped by the router call.
amount is split in half and sent to both fee wallets.
maxTxPercent is multiplied into _tTotal to set the new max transaction amount.
onoff is stored directly into cooldownEnabled.
amt is written directly into the _teamFee state variable.
Each element of bots_ is written into the bots blacklist mapping.
notbot is used to clear the bots blacklist entry.
rAmount is bounded by _rTotal and divided by the current rate.
tAmount is the input used to derive all fee and transfer values.
currentRate holds the value produced by _getRate.
contractTokenBalance is the amount handed to swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance is read from address(this).balance before sendETHToFee.
tFee is computed as tAmount * taxFee / 100.
tTeam is computed as tAmount * TeamFee / 100.
tTransferAmount is computed by subtracting fees from tAmount.
rSupply is decremented for each excluded account.
tSupply is decremented for each excluded account.
_transfer writes the cooldown timestamp for buyers from the pair.
_transfer enforces amount <= _maxTxAmount.
_transfer requires both sender and recipient to be non-blacklisted.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee to decide whether a fee is taken.
_transfer uses _excluded account bookkeeping when computing the contract balance.
_transfer checks inSwap before attempting an automatic swap.
_transfer checks swapEnabled before swapping contract tokens.
_transfer compares addresses against uniswapV2Pair to classify buys and sells.
_transfer validates that the caller is the router when cooldown is enabled.
balanceOf(address(this)) reads _rOwned when computing the contract token balance.
The constructor credits _rTotal of _rOwned to the deployer.
The constructor marks owner, contract and fee wallets as fee exempt.
The constructor stores the supplied fee address.
The constructor stores the supplied marketing wallet address.
Ownable's constructor sets _owner to the deployer.
transfer always calls _transfer before returning true.
transferFrom calls _transfer before reducing the allowance.
transferFrom calls _approve to decrement the spender allowance.
transferFrom reads the current allowance from _allowances.
approve delegates the allowance write to _approve.
balanceOf checks _isExcluded to choose which balance mapping to return.
balanceOf returns the token-denominated balance for excluded accounts.
balanceOf reads the reflection balance for non-excluded accounts.
balanceOf converts reflection balances through tokenFromReflection.
setCooldownEnabled writes the cooldownEnabled flag.
approveBonus overwrites the _teamFee state variable without updating the saved previous value.
setBots writes true into the bots blacklist for each supplied address.
delBot writes false into the bots blacklist for the supplied address.
openTrading stores the mainnet router address into uniswapV2Router.
openTrading stores the created pair into uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading sets tradingOpen to true as its replay guard.
openTrading enables swapEnabled for automatic fee swaps.
openTrading enables cooldownEnabled.
openTrading resets _maxTxAmount to the full total supply.
openTrading approves the router and the pair over the token allowance mapping.
setMaxTxPercent rewrites _maxTxAmount.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to address(0).
_approve writes the allowance into _allowances.
swapTokensForEth queries WETH and swaps through uniswapV2Router.
swapTokensForEth approves the router through _approve.
sendETHToFee transfers half of the ETH to _FeeAddress.
sendETHToFee transfers half of the ETH to _marketingWalletAddress.
_getValues reads the current _taxFee for fee computation.
_getValues reads the current _teamFee for team cut computation.
_getValues calls _getRate to obtain the conversion rate.
_getValues calls _getTValues for token-denominated amounts.
_getValues calls _getRValues for reflection-denominated amounts.
_getRate divides the supplies returned by _getCurrentSupply.
_getCurrentSupply iterates _rOwned balances of excluded accounts.
_getCurrentSupply iterates _tOwned balances of excluded accounts.
_getCurrentSupply loops over the _excluded address array.
_getCurrentSupply starts from and can fall back to _rTotal.
tokenFromReflection requires rAmount <= _rTotal.
tokenFromReflection converts using the rate from _getRate.
removeAllFee saves and zeroes _taxFee.
removeAllFee saves and zeroes _teamFee.
restoreAllFee restores the saved _taxFee.
restoreAllFee restores the saved _teamFee.
_transfer hands the movement to _tokenTransfer with the takeFee decision.
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth for accumulated contract tokens.
_transfer triggers sendETHToFee after the swap produces ETH.
_tokenTransfer branches on the _isExcluded status of sender and recipient.
_tokenTransfer calls removeAllFee for fee-exempt transfers.
_tokenTransfer calls restoreAllFee after a fee-exempt transfer.
_tokenTransfer routes to _transferStandard for non-excluded pairs.
_tokenTransfer routes to _transferToExcluded when the recipient is excluded.
_tokenTransfer routes to _transferFromExcluded when the sender is excluded.
_tokenTransfer routes to _transferBothExcluded when both are excluded.
_transferStandard debits sender and credits recipient in _rOwned.
_transferStandard obtains amounts from _getValues.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam for the team portion.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee for the reflection fee.
_transferToExcluded updates reflection balances of both parties.
_transferToExcluded credits the recipient's token-denominated balance.
_transferToExcluded obtains amounts from _getValues.
_transferToExcluded calls _takeTeam.
_transferToExcluded calls _reflectFee.
_transferFromExcluded updates reflection balances of both parties.
_transferFromExcluded debits the sender's token-denominated balance.
_transferFromExcluded obtains amounts from _getValues.
_transferFromExcluded calls _takeTeam.
_transferFromExcluded calls _reflectFee.
_transferBothExcluded updates reflection balances of both parties.
_transferBothExcluded updates token-denominated balances of both parties.
_transferBothExcluded obtains amounts from _getValues.
_transferBothExcluded calls _takeTeam.
_transferBothExcluded calls _reflectFee.
_takeTeam credits the contract's own reflection balance.
_takeTeam credits the contract's token-denominated balance if excluded.
_takeTeam converts the team amount using _getRate.
_reflectFee subtracts the reflection fee from _rTotal.
_reflectFee accumulates the token fee in _tFeeTotal.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth on the whole contract balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee on the whole contract ETH balance.
openTrading performs the initial addLiquidityETH call.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call.
sendETHToFee performs the ETH transfers to the fee wallets.
Half of the ETH sent through the transfer operation leaves to _FeeAddress.
The Uniswap swap moves tokens and can call back into the token's transfer logic; the inSwap flag is the only guard.
addLiquidityETH pulls tokens via transferFrom, re-entering the token's transfer path before tradingOpen is set.
The library low-level call{value:} hands control to an arbitrary recipient contract that can re-enter token transfer logic.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter `from` only steers branch decisions and balance updates inside _transfer.
Parameter `to` only steers branch decisions and balance updates inside _transfer.
Parameter `amount` is consumed by the max-tx check and the internal token transfer in _transfer.
Parameter tokenAmount exists only to be approved and swapped in swapTokensForEth.
Parameter amount is split and transferred by sendETHToFee.
Parameter maxTxPercent is only used to recompute _maxTxAmount in setMaxTxPercent.
Parameter onoff is directly stored by setCooldownEnabled.
Parameter amt is directly stored as _teamFee by approveBonus.
Parameter bots_ is iterated and written into the blacklist by setBots.
Parameter notbot is only used to clear a blacklist entry in delBot.
Parameter rAmount is validated and divided by the rate inside tokenFromReflection.
Parameter tAmount is the sole input used to derive all transfer values in _getValues.
Local currentRate is the cached result of _getRate used by tokenFromReflection.
Local contractTokenBalance is captured in _transfer and forwarded to the swap helper.
Local contractETHBalance is captured in _transfer to decide whether to distribute ETH.
Local tFee is the token fee computed inside _getTValues.
Local tTeam is the team portion computed inside _getTValues.
Local tTransferAmount is the net amount computed inside _getTValues.
Local rSupply tracks the running reflection supply inside _getCurrentSupply.
Local tSupply tracks the running token supply inside _getCurrentSupply.
